Setup and teardown keywords run around your tests so each starts from a known
state and cleans up after itself:

- **Suite Setup / Suite Teardown** — once, before and after the whole suite.
- **`[Setup]` / `[Teardown]`** — before and after one test case.

A teardown runs **even if the test failed**, which makes it the right place for
cleanup. Set suite-level ones in `*** Settings ***`; set per-test ones inside
the test.

```diagram
sequence "Setup and teardown execution order"
Suite Setup @ -- once, before the whole suite
[Setup] @ -- before this test
Test body @ -- the assertions run
[Teardown] @ -- after the test, even if it failed
Suite Teardown @ -- once, after the whole suite
note "A teardown runs even if the test failed"
```

## Task 1 — Add suite and test setup/teardown

**Goal:** create `checks/lifecycle.robot` with a suite-level setup and teardown
and a test that also has its own `[Setup]` and `[Teardown]`.

Here is the same lifecycle over different messages. Adapt the wording.

<!-- example -->
```robotframework
*** Settings ***
Suite Setup       Log    Warming up
Suite Teardown    Log    Shutting down

*** Test Cases ***
Uses A Lifecycle
    [Setup]    Log    Getting ready
    [Teardown]    Log    Tidying up
    Should Be Equal    on    on
```
<!-- /example -->

**Check:** `checks/lifecycle.robot` defines a Suite Setup, and the test passes.

<!-- hint -->
In `*** Settings ***`, add `Suite Setup    Log    Opening the suite` and
`Suite Teardown    Log    Closing the suite`.
<!-- /hint -->
<!-- hint -->
Inside the test, add `[Setup]    Log    ...` and `[Teardown]    Log    ...`, then
a simple passing assertion.
<!-- /hint -->
<!-- solution -->
```robotframework
*** Settings ***
Suite Setup       Log    Opening the suite
Suite Teardown    Log    Closing the suite

*** Test Cases ***
Runs With Lifecycle
    [Setup]    Log    Preparing the test
    [Teardown]    Log    Cleaning up the test
    Should Be Equal    ready    ready
```
<!-- /solution -->

## Task 2 — Run the suite green

Run it:

```bash
uv run robot checks
```

Open `log.html` to see the setup and teardown wrapped around the test.

**Check:** the test `Runs With Lifecycle` passes.
